name: Sustainable Energy Engineering Honours

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The program requires a cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and an upper division grade point average (UDGPA) of at least 3.0 in accordance with university graduation requirements.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Within their program, students must also complete technical, interdisciplinary and complementary studies electives as indicated below.

sections.note:
The following core courses are required for the sustainable energy engineering honours and cannot be substituted for "equivalent" courses in other areas without prior approval. "Equivalent" courses taken without prior approval will not be applied to graduation requirements.
Students should consult an academic advisor within their program for details on obtaining permission.
A grade of C- or better in prerequisite courses is required to enroll in sustainable energy engineering courses.

sections.title: Technical Elective Courses

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete three technical elective courses from the following SEE Technical Elective list.

sections.note:
With permission from the SEE undergraduate curriculum committee chair, students may replace one technical elective with either a directed study ( SEE 486 ) or a special project laboratory course.
Approved special topics courses may also be counted here.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: To contribute to the program’s focus on interdisciplinary knowledge, students must also take one of the following interdisciplinary electives.

sections.title: Complementary Studies Elective Courses

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The Canadian Engineering Accreditation Board (CEAB) requires that one complementary studies elective within the SEE curriculum meet the requirements for classification as a Central Issues, Methodologies, and Thought Processes course.

sections.note: Within the SEE curriculum, the course BUS 238 – Introduction to Entrepreneurship and Innovation, meets this requirement.

sections.title: Other requirements
sections.note: Please see Faculty of Applied Sciences Residency Requirements for further information.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
